translations.web: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
translations.bsb: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
translations.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
translations.asv: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
